verdict.rationale: cubic's docs say it scans every PR for logic errors and security vulnerabilities, not just style (cubic-docs-47), and comments on bugs (cubic-docs-19). Ultrareview adds a deeper multi-pass analysis for risky changes (cubic-docs-48), Datadog integration lets agents check findings against production logs (cubic-docs-73), and thumbs-up/down feedback helps it calibrate signal versus noise (cubic-docs-33). One community user says it gives more technical explanations than basic checks (cubic-comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit coverage of race conditions and edge cases, independent accuracy or benchmark data, and hands-on evidence of real bugs caught beyond one anecdotal comment.
